svg.text: VLAN 30 device network · RSTP root bridge

Chained devices use the two RJ45 ports of NTSNEC1200K and PAS600. Each local switch needs 2 × SFP single-mode ports and ≥ 6 copper ports. SW2 needs 2 SFP ports: MCSESM083F23F1 is copper only – add media converters or select an FO variant (TBC).
Fibre: 4-core single-mode armoured cable per link in the cable trenches (1200×1000 / 800×1000). Route lengths to be taken from the LV cable route drawings.
Ring recovery time with RSTP < 1 s. The M580 RIO link (main rack ↔ Rack 2) is a separate EtherNet/IP segment on NOC/CPU ports and does not pass through SW1 or SW2.

1. Read with sheet 001. Addresses are proposals for
approval; final values to be fixed at FAT.
2. All switches managed: unused ports shut down, port
security (MAC binding), SNMPv3, syslog to SRV-01, RSTP
3. IP forwarding on BMENOC0321 is restricted to SCADA ↔
device traffic; no other routing between VLANs except
inverters daisy-chained to one PLC box. The offer
provides one NTSFMB0120K per PV area, so
point-to-point links are proposed for faster polling
5. Field switches LS-xx, SFP ports on SW2 and fibre cables
6. All devices take time from GPS-01 via NTP; P5M30 event
